name: daily-loop
description: A lightweight, mobile-first daily task app with server-checked streaks, points and badges.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @daily-loop/api" "npm run dev -w @daily-loop/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @daily-loop/api && npm run build -w @daily-loop/web
